scope: offline short frame analysis; host FAIL remains FAIL; no bit/byte/edge repair
ready_count_policy: informational only; phase3 intentionally delays READY; no PASS/FAIL based on count
timebase_policy: nominal metadata time only; compare TX period to expected; common-factor mismatch has no assigned cause
limits: 10ns digitizer resolution cannot prove internal setup/hold or analog edges
Probe edges are not internal P4 sampling events
Each phase samples one whole frame; no per-byte choice or deleted edges
